findings: EMA is not the observed bottleneck: mature raw2000=97.3774, EMA2000=97.0806, CV=96.5087mm.
Mature raw code improves .713194->.668717 while world FK MPJPE worsens; own-reference valid projection changes P code loss to .695422 without changing physical body.

Common CV-frame valid-state comparison gives CV=.584921 and P=.585270, removing apparent mature code advantage. This changes the diagnostic feature/label metric and is not an orthogonal decomposition.
P raw6D body basis norms=.9423/.9319 vs CV1/1. Pure scale/orthogonality freedom can lower loss without improving decoded rotations.
Unchanged CV physical body reencoded with P reference lowers code .713194->.692433, proving reference-gauge sensitivity, not a deployable inference improvement.
Conditional replacement of P beta by CV beta improves .41998mm but still leaves .15193mm mature regression; predicted beta continues to participate FK.
Startup25% weighted total gradient norm is97.0% of mature75%; phase cosine .0084 and mixed-to-mature-geometry cosine .0608 do not support sustained strongly opposite gradients.
Seen mature training samples worsen .12755mm despite lower weighted training loss; val overfit/unseen rows alone do not explain failure.
Mature official foot-slide delta4.0761mm splits motion .3545 and height weighting3.7216mm; fixed GT-height weighting shows +3.75% rather than49%. Gate remains unchanged.
GT-height contact MAE improves3.140mm (112clips), noncontact MAE worsens4.076mm (120clips); partial hover correction accompanies worsened raised-foot height.
All2000 sampling traces and saved rank sampler states reproduce. GT labels sampled8rows/split match; GT code FK error~.0002mm. No evidence requiring bank rebuild.
limits: One seed/2k budget, D128 development data; not independent test or full convergence proof.
Projection includes6D normalization/orthogonalization plus canonical-reference plane projection; do not attribute all code-loss difference to yaw.
Physical-factor Shapley distributes interactions; conditional beta reversion reported separately.
Per-clip mean optimal XYZ-alpha is not a global scalar and differs from normalized-code interpolation.
Gradient cosines are eval-mode/unpreconditioned mean gradients, not AdamW updates.
Height contacts and negative-z are joint proxies; GT also has negative joints, conditional subgroup populations differ.
No P02 or final-G gain has been demonstrated.
next_controlled_protocol_candidates: A: same bank/seed/budget, replace raw-code objective with valid-state supervision in a shared causal CV reference; use world FK to assess actual geometry.
B: same as A, hold beta from CV/G last state; keep predicted-beta FK. Compare A vsP01 and B vsA.
For first A/B hold the existing geometry coefficient fixed and log changed gradient ratios; any later weight change gets its own train-calibrated control.
Only after P improves physical prediction proceed to G adaptation/U; FFT remains separate. No automatic P01 extension.
